description_en: The business license verification service checks for consistency across three key elements: the Unified Social Credit Code (or business registration number), the company name, and the legal representative's name
description_zh: 营业执照三要素核验支持通过输入营业执照的统一信用社会代码（工商注册号）、企业名称、法人姓名做一致性验证
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api verify-business-license --credit-code 91330110MA2AXY0E7F --company-name '阿里巴巴达摩院（杭州）科技有限公司' --legal-person '张建锋' --region cn-hangzhou
name: VerifyBusinessLicense

parameters.help_en: The business registration number or Unified Social Credit Code
parameters.help_zh: 企业注册号或统一社会信用代码
parameters.name: credit_code

parameters.example: 阿里巴巴达摩院（杭州）科技有限公司
parameters.name: company_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the company's legal representative
parameters.name: legal_person

Data.example: {"code":"0","data":true,"message":"法人姓名、社会信用代码一致"}

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request
